_comment: PROTECTED — the trading agent may not edit this file or anything in core/. Changes here are made by the human operator only.

screener._comment: Tunables for the screening tier (core/screen.py). Screening judgment comes from Haiku subagents the cycle agent fans out with its Task tool, so the day's cost is counted in batches, not dollars - there is no API path and no model field. The max_batches_per_day and max_pool_after_strata hard ceilings live in core/validate.py and core/screen.py; raising either is a protected-core edit by design.

real._comment: Caps for real execution via Pearl Connect (laptop only). Hard ceilings live in core/validate.py; raising them is a protected-core edit by design.

venues._comment: Venues beyond international Polymarket, paper only (operator, 2026-11-11). pmus = Polymarket US via its public gateway (core/venue_pmus.py); kalshi = Kalshi via its public API (core/venue_kalshi.py). max_spread is the widest best bid/ask gap a scanned market may have; max_candidates caps how many reach the screener per scan; kalshi.min_volume_24h is in contracts. polymarket.enabled=false (operator, 2026-11-13) switches international Polymarket off for new scans, forecasts, bets and watch triggers; rows already recorded there still settle and score. Kalshi and Polymarket US candidate caps raised 150 -> 250 so the screen pool stays full. non_sports_share reserves that fraction of each venue's candidates for non-sports markets when they exist (operator, 2026-11-13: research beats a consensus sports line rarely).
